def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts8 = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 4]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts8), max(r for r, c in pts8)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts8), max(c for r, c in pts8)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in pts8]
    copies = [shape]
    if len(markers) >= 2:
        (a, b) = markers[0], markers[1]
        dr, dc = b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1]
        # Rotate the marker-to-marker vector clockwise to obtain the copy offset.
        sr, sc = -dc, dr
        copies.append([(r+sr, c+sc) for r, c in shape])
    allpts = [(r,c) for cp in copies for r,c in cp]
    rr0, rr1 = min(r for r,c in allpts), max(r for r,c in allpts)
    cc0, cc1 = min(c for r,c in allpts), max(c for r,c in allpts)
    out = [[0]*(cc1-cc0+1) for _ in range(rr1-rr0+1)]
    for r,c in allpts:
        out[r-rr0][c-cc0] = 8
    return out
